subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose host update execution to gateway-authenticated HTTP callers, and if so should it use the existing opt-in Admin HTTP RPC allowlist or a dedicated endpoint?
rationale: The request expands privileged host package-update and restart authority from existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths to an HTTP surface, so automation cannot choose the permanent security and API boundary safely.

options.title: Split version and design HTTP update first
options.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose update.run through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add a narrow allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper with explicit trusted-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, and managed-handoff proof requirements.

options.title: Decline HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split version and design HTTP update first
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared history across Admin HTTP RPC, Gateway update flow, and adjacent version resolution.
